top_signals.title: Barclays faces legal scrutiny over role in £90m ‘Ponzi scheme within a Ponzi scheme’
top_signals.summary: Barclays could be on the hook for as much as £37m over its role in a collapsed ‘Ponzi scheme’ after failing to dismiss claims brought by the company’s liquidators. The FTSE 100 finance giant provided banking services to a company called Denaro from 2013 until its demise a decade later, at which point it faced [...]
